lines.text: Toby the puppy was chasing his bouncy tennis ball through the sunny kitchen!
Crash! His tail knocked Grandma's favorite yellow flowerpot right off the table!
When Grandma rushed in, Toby panicked and said, A giant monster did it!
Grandma looked worried, but Toby's tummy felt tied in an uncomfortable knot!
Lies feel heavy, like carrying a sharp stone in your shoe all day long!
Toby walked up, looked Grandma in the eye, and whispered, It was my bouncy ball!
Grandma gave him a warm hug and said, Accidents happen, but your honesty is golden!
Telling the truth takes courage, but it heals hearts every single time!
